output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    theme: united
params:
  threads: 1
  input_bgz: NULL
  input_bam: NULL
  reference: NULL
  output_dir: "."
  region: NULL # By default there's no region
  tabix: "tabix" # Assume tabix is available in PATH
  rastair: "rastair" # Assume rastair is available in PATH
  include_flags: 3
  exclude_flags: 3852
  read_len: NULL
  plot_vbias: TRUE
  plot_gc: TRUE
  is_WGBS: FALSE
  plot_offtarget: TRUE
---

```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(ggplot2)
})

parse_position_counts <- function(data, columns) {
  encoded <- unlist(
    lapply(columns, function(column) data[[column]]),
    use.names=FALSE
  )
  encoded <- encoded[!is.na(encoded) & nzchar(encoded)]
  if (length(encoded) == 0L) {
    return(integer())
  }

  positions <- scan(
    text=encoded,
    what=integer(),
    sep=",",
    quiet=TRUE
  )
  tabulate(positions + 1L)
}

position_counts <- function(data, chunk_size=250000L) {
  mod_columns <- c("mod_cpgs", "mod_denovos")
  unmod_columns <- c("unmod_cpgs", "unmod_denovos")
  position_columns <- c(mod_columns, unmod_columns)
  chunk_starts <- seq.int(1L, nrow(data), by=chunk_size)

  chunks <- lapply(chunk_starts, function(first) {
    last <- min(first + chunk_size - 1L, nrow(data))
    chunk <- data[first:last, c("chr", "flag", position_columns), with=FALSE]
    chunk[, `:=`(
      read_pair=factor(
        fifelse(bitwAnd(flag, 64) > 0, "First", "Second"),
        levels=c("First", "Second")
      ),
      strand=factor(
        fifelse(
          bitwAnd(flag, 96) == 96 | bitwAnd(flag, 144) == 144,
          "OT",
          "OB"
        ),
        levels=c("OB", "OT")
      )
    )]

    chunk[, {
      mod <- parse_position_counts(.SD, mod_columns)
      unmod <- parse_position_counts(.SD, unmod_columns)
      num_positions <- max(length(mod), length(unmod))
      mod <- c(mod, integer(num_positions - length(mod)))
      unmod <- c(unmod, integer(num_positions - length(unmod)))
      observed <- which(mod > 0L | unmod > 0L)
      .(
        pos=observed - 1L,
        mod=as.double(mod[observed]),
        unmod=as.double(unmod[observed])
      )
    }, by=.(chr, read_pair, strand), .SDcols=position_columns]
  })

  rbindlist(chunks)[
    , .(mod=sum(mod), unmod=sum(unmod)),
    by=.(chr, read_pair, strand, pos)
  ]
}

expand_positions <- function(data) {
  position_types <- c(
    mod_cpgs="M",
    unmod_cpgs="U",
    snp_cpgs="S",
    mod_denovos="m",
    unmod_denovos="u"
  )

  expanded <- lapply(names(position_types), function(column) {
    encoded <- data[[column]]
    present <- !is.na(encoded) & nzchar(encoded)
    if (!any(present)) {
      result <- data[0L, .(
        chr, start, end, read_id, orientation, insert_size, flag
      )]
      result[, `:=`(
        alignment_id=integer(), pos_in_read=integer(), type=character()
      )]
      return(result)
    }

    positions <- strsplit(as.character(encoded[present]), ",", fixed=TRUE)
    rows <- rep.int(which(present), lengths(positions))
    result <- data[rows, .(
      chr, start, end, read_id, orientation, insert_size, flag
    )]
    result[, `:=`(
      alignment_id=rows,
      pos_in_read=as.integer(unlist(positions, use.names=FALSE)),
      type=unname(position_types[[column]])
    )]
    result
  })

  rbindlist(expanded, use.names=TRUE)
}

assign_position_ordinals <- function(data) {
  setorder(data, alignment_id, pos_in_read)
  data[, ordinal := rowid(alignment_id)]
  data
}

collapse_fragment_cpgs <- function(data) {
  data[, Orientation := fifelse(
    bitwAnd(flag, 96) == 96 | bitwAnd(flag, 144) == 144,
    "OT",
    "OB"
  )]

  group_columns <- c("chr", "read_id", "cpg_id", "insert_size", "Orientation")
  setorderv(data, group_columns)
  repeated <- duplicated(data, by=group_columns) |
    duplicated(data, by=group_columns, fromLast=TRUE)

  singletons <- data[!repeated, .(
    chr,
    read_id,
    cpg_id,
    insert_size,
    Orientation,
    start,
    end,
    pos_in_fragment=start + pos_in_read,
    type=fcase(
      type == "S", "S",
      type %chin% c("U", "u"), "U",
      default="M"
    )
  )]
  multiples <- data[repeated, .(
    start=min(start),
    end=max(end),
    pos_in_fragment=min(start + pos_in_read),
    type=fifelse(
      any(type == "S"),
      "S",
      fifelse(all(type %chin% c("U", "u")), "U", "M")
    )
  ), by=group_columns]

  result <- rbindlist(list(singletons, multiples), use.names=TRUE)
  result[
    Orientation == "OT",
    pos_in_fragment := pos_in_fragment - min(start),
    by=.(chr, read_id)
  ]
  result[
    Orientation == "OB",
    pos_in_fragment := max(end) - pos_in_fragment,
    by=.(chr, read_id)
  ]
  result
}


# For a subset of observations of read orientation on one strand,
# calculate the suggested cutoff points
calculate_cutoff <- function(mbias_table) {
  # Ensure we process things in orders
  mbias_table <- mbias_table[order(mbias_table$pos),]
  # get the mean beta of the middle 60% of the data
  n_obs <- nrow(mbias_table)
  if (n_obs < 3) {
    # Too few points for a meaningful cutoff; report no trimming rather than
    # aborting the whole render. Callers skip sparse contigs before reaching
    # here, so this is a defensive fallback.
    return(data.frame(left=as.double(0), right=as.double(0)))
  }
  upper_lim <- min(ceiling(n_obs * 0.8), n_obs-1)
  lower_lim <- max(floor(n_obs * 0.2), 2)
  mean_middle <- mean(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$beta)
  upper_ci_max <- max(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$upper_ci)
  lower_ci_min <- min(mbias_table[lower_lim:upper_lim,]$lower_ci)

  # Search from the inside out for the first point left/right that is
  # either outside the 95% CI bounds of the middle, or the mean of the
  # middle is outside the CI of the point, or it's more than 0.05 away
  # from the mean of the middle
  check_match <- function(row, mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max) {
    if (is.na(mean_middle) || is.null(mean_middle) || is.na(row$beta) || is.null(row$beta) || is.na(lower_ci_min) || is.null(lower_ci_min) || is.na(upper_ci_max) || is.null(upper_ci_max)) {
      return(FALSE)
    }

    if (!row$beta %between% c(lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max)
        && abs(row$beta - mean_middle) > 0.05
        && !mean_middle %between% c(row$lower_ci, row$upper_ci)) {
      return(TRUE)
    }

    return(FALSE)
  }

  left_cutoff = 0
  right_cutoff = 0

  middle = ceiling(n_obs/2)
  for (pos in middle:1) {
    if (check_match(mbias_table[pos,], mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max)) {
      left_cutoff = pos
      break
    }
  }
  for (pos in 1:(n_obs-middle)) {
    if (check_match(mbias_table[middle+pos,], mean_middle, lower_ci_min, upper_ci_max)) {
      right_cutoff = n_obs - (middle+pos) + 1
      break
    }
  }
  return(data.frame(left=as.double(left_cutoff), right=as.double(right_cutoff)))
}
```

```{r transform_data, include=FALSE}
# if no bgz given, but a bam file is provided, generate bed file on the fly
if ((is.na(params$input_bgz) || is.null(params$input_bgz) || nchar(params$input_bgz)==0 || !file.exists(params$input_bgz)) && !is.na(params$input_bam) && !is.null(params$input_bam) && nchar(params$input_bam)>0 && file.exists(params$input_bam)) {
  if (is.na(params$reference) || is.null(params$reference) || nchar(params$reference)==0 || !file.exists(params$reference)) {
    stop("Cannot run from bam file without a reference")
  }

  if (!is.na(params$region) && nchar(params$region) > 0) {
    command=paste(params$rastair, "per-read --bed - -r", params$reference, "-l", params$region, "-f", params$include_flags, "-F", params$exclude_flags, "-@", params$threads, params$input_bam)
  } else {
    command=paste(params$rastair, "per-read --bed - -r", params$reference, "-f", params$include_flags, "-F", params$exclude_flags, "-@", params$threads, params$input_bam)
  }
} else if (!(is.na(params$input_bgz) || is.null(params$input_bgz) || nchar(params$input_bgz)==0 || !file.exists(params$input_bgz))) {
  if (!is.na(params$region) && nchar(params$region) > 0) {
    command=paste(params$tabix, "-h", params$input_bgz, params$region)
  } else {
    command=paste("bgzip -cd", params$input_bgz)
  }
}  else {
  stop("Neither per-read bgz nor bam file given, cannot proceed")
}

data <- fread(cmd=command, header=TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
setnames(data, 1, "chr")
data[, chr := as.factor(chr)]
data[, orientation := as.factor(orientation)]

if (!is.null(params$is_WGBS) && params$is_WGBS == TRUE) {
  setnames(data, c("mod_cpgs", "unmod_cpgs", "mod_denovos", "unmod_denovos"), c("unmod_cpgs", "mod_cpgs", "unmod_denovos", "mod_denovos"))
}

data <- data[
  num_cpg > 0 &
    bitwAnd(flag, params$include_flags) == params$include_flags &
    bitwAnd(flag, params$exclude_flags) == 0
]

if (is.null(params$read_len) || is.na(params$read_len) || !is.numeric(params$read_len)) {
  read_len <- max(data$read_length, na.rm=TRUE)
} else {
  read_len = params$read_len
}

dedup_columns <- c(
  "chr", "start", "end", "read_id", "mapq", "orientation", "insert_size",
  "read_length", "flag", "mod_cpgs", "unmod_cpgs", "snp_cpgs",
  "mod_denovos", "unmod_denovos"
)
data <- unique(data, by=dedup_columns)
data[, c("mapq", "read_length", "num_cpg", "num_mod") := NULL]
invisible(gc())

mbias_table <- position_counts(data)

# Flip the OB reads so that mbias is always reported 5' -> 3'
mbias_table[(strand=="OT" & read_pair == "Second") | (strand=="OB" & read_pair == "First"), pos := read_len-pos]
mbias_table <- mbias_table[, .(beta=mod/(mod+unmod), lower_ci=ifelse(mod+unmod>0, binom.test(mod, mod+unmod, conf.level = 0.999)$conf.int[1], 0.0), upper_ci=ifelse(mod+unmod>0, binom.test(mod, mod+unmod, conf.level = 0.999)$conf.int[2], 0.0)), by=.(chr, pos, read_pair, strand)]
mbias_table <- mbias_table[!is.na(beta)]
setkey(mbias_table, chr, pos)

if (isTRUE(params$plot_gc)) {
  read_info <- data[, .(chr, start, mod_cpgs, unmod_cpgs)]
}
if (!isTRUE(params$plot_vbias)) {
  rm(data)
  invisible(gc())
}
```

## M-bias plots

```{r plot_mbias, echo=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=7}
# A cutoff needs at least this many covered read positions in a
# read_pair/strand group to be meaningful. Tiny alt/decoy contigs in
# full-genome BAMs often fall short in at least one group.
MIN_MBIAS_OBS <- 3
# When the run is explicitly scoped to a region/chromosome, a sparse contig is
# an error: the user asked for exactly this data and we can't honour it. For a
# genome-wide run we skip sparse contigs (e.g. tiny alt/decoy contigs) and warn,
# so they don't abort the whole report.
region_given <- !is.na(params$region) && nchar(params$region) > 0
skipped_contigs <- character(0)
for (chrom in unique(mbias_table$chr)) {
  group_sizes <- mbias_table[chr==chrom, .N, by=.(read_pair, strand)]
  if (any(group_sizes$N < MIN_MBIAS_OBS)) {
    if (region_given) {
      stop(sprintf("Not enough data points to calculate cutoffs for %s: a read_pair/strand group has <%d covered read positions", chrom, MIN_MBIAS_OBS))
    }
    skipped_contigs <- c(skipped_contigs, as.character(chrom))
    next
  }
  cutoffs <- mbias_table[chr==chrom, calculate_cutoff(as.data.frame(.SD)), by=.(chr, read_pair, strand)]
  print(cutoffs)
  #write cutoffs to file if requested
  if (!is.na(params$output_dir) && !is.null(params$output_dir)) {
    out_table <- cutoffs[, .(l_ot = .SD[read_pair=="First", left],
                             r_ot = .SD[read_pair=="First", right],
                             l_ob = .SD[read_pair=="Second", left],
                             r_ob = .SD[read_pair=="Second", right]),
                         by=strand]
    setDF(out_table)
    write.table(out_table[order(out_table[,1], decreasing=TRUE),2:5], file.path(params$output_dir, paste0(chrom, "_cutoffs.txt")), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote=FALSE, sep=",")
  }

  g <- ggplot(mbias_table[chr==chrom], aes(x=pos, y=beta, color=read_pair)) +
        geom_line() +
        geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=lower_ci, ymax=upper_ci, fill=read_pair), alpha=0.2) +
        labs(color = "Read") +
        xlab("Position in read (5'->3')") +
        scale_color_discrete(labels=c('First in pair', 'Second in pair')) +
        scale_fill_discrete(guide="none") +
        theme_light()
  if(!is.null(cutoffs)) {
    g = g + geom_vline(aes(xintercept=left, color=read_pair), data=cutoffs)
    g = g + geom_vline(aes(xintercept=read_len-right, color=read_pair), data=cutoffs)
  }
  g = g + facet_wrap(vars(strand), nrow = 2, as.table = FALSE)
  g = g + ggtitle(chrom)

  print(g)
}
if (length(skipped_contigs) > 0) {
  warning(sprintf(
    "Skipped M-bias plots/cutoffs for %d contig(s) with <%d covered read positions in a read_pair/strand group: %s",
    length(skipped_contigs), MIN_MBIAS_OBS, paste(skipped_contigs, collapse=", ")))
}
```

## V-bias plots

```{r transform_vbias, include=FALSE}
if (params$plot_vbias) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Rsamtools)
    library(GenomicRanges)
    library(Biostrings)
    library(ggside)
  })

  if (is.na(params$reference) || nchar(params$reference)==0 || !file.exists(params$reference)) {
    stop("V-Bias plot required a reference fasta file")
  }

  # The C of every reference CpG, per contig; a contig the reference lacks
  # has none
  reference_lengths <- seqlengths(scanFaIndex(params$reference))
  contigs <- as.character(unique(data$chr))
  cpg_positions <- setNames(lapply(contigs, function(contig) {
    if (!(contig %in% names(reference_lengths))) {
      return(integer())
    }
    dna <- scanFa(params$reference, param = GRanges(contig, IRanges::IRanges(1L, reference_lengths[[contig]])))[[1]]
    start(matchPattern("CG", dna, fixed = TRUE))
  }), contigs)

  readPositions <- unique(data[, .(chr, start, end, orientation)])
  readPositions[, c("first_cpg_id", "last_cpg_id") := {
    positions <- cpg_positions[[as.character(chr[[1L]])]]
    if (is.null(positions) || length(positions) == 0L) {
      list(rep.int(1L, .N), rep.int(0L, .N))
    } else {
      # A CpG overlaps [start, end] when its C lies in [start - 1, end].
      list(
        findInterval(start - 2L, positions) + 1L,
        findInterval(end, positions)
      )
    }
  }, by=chr]

  vdata <- expand_positions(data)
  vdata <- assign_position_ordinals(vdata)
  vdata[readPositions, on=.(chr, start, end, orientation), `:=`(
    first_cpg_id=i.first_cpg_id,
    last_cpg_id=i.last_cpg_id
  )]
  vdata[, cpg_id := first_cpg_id + ordinal - 1L]
  vdata <- vdata[!is.na(first_cpg_id) & cpg_id <= last_cpg_id]
  vdata[, c("first_cpg_id", "last_cpg_id") := NULL]

  rm(data, cpg_positions, readPositions)
  vdata <- collapse_fragment_cpgs(vdata)
}
```

```{r plot_vbias, echo=FALSE, fig.height=4, fig.width=7, warning=FALSE}
if (params$plot_vbias) {
  for (chrom in unique(vdata$chr)) {

    # main aggregated data (your tiles)
    vdata_plot <- vdata[
      chr == chrom & pos_in_fragment < insert_size,
      .(beta = sum(type == "M") / .N,
        observations = .N),
      by = .(`Pos in fragment` = pos_in_fragment,
             `Insert size` = insert_size,
             Orientation)
    ]

    # collapse to counts per Insert size per Orientation (this is what you want plotted)
    side_counts <- vdata_plot[
      , .(obs = sum(observations)),
      by = .(`Insert size`, Orientation)
    ]
    side_counts[, obs_pdf:=obs/sum(obs), by=.(Orientation)]

    p <- ggplot(vdata_plot, aes(x = `Pos in fragment`, y = `Insert size`, fill = beta)) +
      geom_tile() +

      # left side panel: counts vs Insert size (one per facet via Orientation)
      geom_ysidebar(
        data = side_counts,
        aes(y = `Insert size`, x = obs_pdf),   # x in side panel = obs, y aligns with main y
        inherit.aes = FALSE,
        stat = "identity",
        orientation = "y"
      ) +
      ggside(y.pos = "left") +

      scale_ysidex_reverse() +

      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "black", mid = "orange", high = "purple", midpoint = 0.5) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 600), expand = c(0, 0)) +
      scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 600), expand = c(0, 0)) +

      ggtitle(chrom) +
      facet_wrap(vars(Orientation)) +

      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        panel.grid = element_blank(),

        # make the side panel look like an annotation
        ggside.panel.grid = element_blank(),
        ggside.axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        ggside.axis.text.x  = element_blank(),  # removes the side-panel x tick labels
        ggside.axis.ticks.x = element_blank()   # (optional) removes the tick marks too
      )

    print(p)
  }
  rm(vdata)
  invisible({gc()})
}
```

## CpG/GC bias

```{r read_bias, include=FALSE}
if (params$plot_gc) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Rsamtools)
    library(Biostrings)
    library(ggside)
  })
  if (is.na(params$reference) || nchar(params$reference) == 0 || !file.exists(params$reference)) {
    stop("GC/CpG bias plots need a reference fasta file")
  }

  # Under random fragmentation reads start uniformly along the genome, so
  # the CpG count and GC share of reads should follow those of all read-long
  # windows of the reference that hold no N. Both are taken from the
  # reference, since conversion changes the Cs a read shows. Only reads with
  # a CpG are in the per-read data, so reads and windows are compared among
  # those covering at least one.
  WINDOW_BLOCK <- 10000000L
  GC_BIN_PERCENT <- 2
  MIN_READS_PER_BIN <- 20L
  window_len <- as.integer(read_len)
  in_window <- function(window_start, positions, width) {
    findInterval(window_start + width - 1L, positions) - findInterval(window_start - 1L, positions)
  }
  # Per-read positions are offsets into the read: OT reads give a CpG's C,
  # OB reads its G. A call off both (an indel or clip before it) is dropped.
  methylation_calls <- function(read_start, encoded, methylated, cpg) {
    present <- !is.na(encoded) & nzchar(encoded)
    offsets <- strsplit(encoded[present], ",", fixed = TRUE)
    read <- rep(which(present), lengths(offsets))
    position <- read_start[read] + as.integer(unlist(offsets))
    site <- findInterval(position, cpg)
    on_cpg <- site > 0L & position - cpg[pmax(site, 1L)] <= 1L
    data.table(read = read[on_cpg], site = site[on_cpg], methylated = methylated)
  }
  # A window's CpG count, GC bin and presumed number of methylated CpGs:
  # the sum of the levels of its CpGs, NA if one of them has no level. A
  # CpG counts when both its C and its G lie in the window.
  describe_windows <- function(window_start, cpg, gc, cum_level, cum_unknown) {
    before <- findInterval(window_start - 1L, cpg)
    through <- findInterval(window_start + window_len - 2L, cpg)
    data.table(
      cpgs = through - before,
      gc = GC_BIN_PERCENT * round(100 * in_window(window_start, gc, window_len) / window_len / GC_BIN_PERCENT),
      methylated = fifelse(
        cum_unknown[through + 1L] == cum_unknown[before + 1L],
        round(cum_level[through + 1L] - cum_level[before + 1L]),
        NA_real_
      )
    )
  }

  # A CpG's level comes from a random half of the reads; only the other half
  # is counted by presumed methylation, so a read never sets the level it is
  # binned by
  set.seed(1)
  reference_lengths <- seqlengths(scanFaIndex(params$reference))
  observed <- list(cpgs = list(), methylated = list())
  expected <- list(cpgs = list(), methylated = list())
  for (contig in intersect(as.character(unique(read_info$chr)), names(reference_lengths))) {
    dna <- scanFa(params$reference, param = GRanges(contig, IRanges::IRanges(1L, reference_lengths[[contig]])))[[1]]
    cpg <- start(matchPattern("CG", dna, fixed = TRUE))
    gc <- start(matchPattern("S", dna, fixed = c(pattern = FALSE, subject = TRUE)))
    gaps <- start(matchPattern("N", dna, fixed = TRUE))
    last_start <- reference_lengths[[contig]] - window_len + 1L
    reads <- read_info[chr == contig]
    reads[, start := start + 1L]
    reads <- reads[start <= last_start]
    reads <- reads[in_window(start, gaps, window_len) == 0L]
    if (nrow(reads) == 0L) {
      next
    }

    in_level_half <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), nrow(reads), replace = TRUE)
    calls <- rbind(
      methylation_calls(reads$start, reads$mod_cpgs, TRUE, cpg),
      methylation_calls(reads$start, reads$unmod_cpgs, FALSE, cpg)
    )[in_level_half[read]]
    levels <- calls[, .(level = mean(methylated)), by = site]
    site_level <- rep(NA_real_, length(cpg))
    site_level[levels$site] <- levels$level
    cum_level <- c(0, cumsum(fifelse(is.na(site_level), 0, site_level)))
    cum_unknown <- c(0L, cumsum(is.na(site_level)))

    described <- describe_windows(reads$start, cpg, gc, cum_level, cum_unknown)
    described[, counted := !in_level_half]
    described <- described[cpgs >= 1L]
    observed$cpgs[[contig]] <- described[, .N, by = .(cpgs, gc)]
    observed$methylated[[contig]] <- described[counted & !is.na(methylated), .N, by = .(methylated, gc)]
    # Expected windows start where the reads do, i.e. over the region
    for (block in seq(min(reads$start), max(reads$start), by = WINDOW_BLOCK)) {
      window_start <- seq(block, min(block + WINDOW_BLOCK - 1L, max(reads$start)))
      window_start <- window_start[in_window(window_start, gaps, window_len) == 0L]
      windows <- describe_windows(window_start, cpg, gc, cum_level, cum_unknown)[cpgs >= 1L]
      expected$cpgs[[length(expected$cpgs) + 1L]] <- windows[, .N, by = .(cpgs, gc)]
      expected$methylated[[length(expected$methylated) + 1L]] <- windows[!is.na(methylated), .N, by = .(methylated, gc)]
    }
  }
  rm(read_info, reads, calls, levels, site_level, cum_level, cum_unknown, described, windows, dna, cpg, gc, gaps)

  share <- function(counts) counts / sum(counts)
  # Reads vs. expected by `by`, raw and with each window weighted by how
  # over- or under-represented its GC share is among the reads
  deviation_by <- function(by) {
    joint <- merge(
      rbindlist(observed[[by]])[, .(observed = sum(N)), by = c(by, "gc")],
      rbindlist(expected[[by]])[, .(expected = sum(N)), by = c(by, "gc")],
      by = c(by, "gc"), all = TRUE
    )
    setnames(joint, by, "x")
    joint[is.na(observed), observed := 0]
    joint[is.na(expected), expected := 0]
    # The top 1% of reads are pooled into the last bin
    reads_by_x <- joint[, .(observed = sum(observed)), keyby = x]
    cap <- reads_by_x[, x[which(cumsum(observed) >= 0.99 * sum(observed))[1]]]
    joint <- joint[, .(observed = sum(observed), expected = sum(expected)), by = .(x = pmin(x, cap), gc)]
    by_gc <- joint[, .(observed = sum(observed), expected = sum(expected)), keyby = gc][expected > 0]
    by_gc[, gc_effect := share(observed) / share(expected)]
    by_x <- joint[by_gc[, .(gc, gc_effect)], on = "gc", nomatch = NULL][
      , .(observed = sum(observed), expected = sum(expected), gc_adjusted = sum(expected * gc_effect)), keyby = x]
    by_x[, `:=`(
      raw = 100 * (share(observed) / share(expected) - 1),
      adjusted = 100 * (share(observed) / share(gc_adjusted) - 1)
    )]
    list(by_x = by_x[observed >= MIN_READS_PER_BIN], by_gc = by_gc[observed >= MIN_READS_PER_BIN], cap = cap)
  }
  cpg_bias <- deviation_by("cpgs")
  methylation_bias <- deviation_by("methylated")

  covariate_labels <- c(
    cpg = sprintf("CpGs in a %d bp read (last bin: %d or more)", window_len, cpg_bias$cap),
    methylated = sprintf("Presumably methylated CpGs (last bin: %d or more)", methylation_bias$cap),
    gc = sprintf("GC in a %d bp read (%%)", window_len)
  )
  series_labels <- c(raw = "Reads vs. expected", adjusted = "After accounting for GC")
  read_lines <- rbind(
    cpg_bias$by_x[, .(covariate = "cpg", x, series = "raw", deviation = raw)],
    cpg_bias$by_x[, .(covariate = "cpg", x, series = "adjusted", deviation = adjusted)],
    methylation_bias$by_x[, .(covariate = "methylated", x, series = "raw", deviation = raw)],
    methylation_bias$by_x[, .(covariate = "methylated", x, series = "adjusted", deviation = adjusted)],
    cpg_bias$by_gc[, .(covariate = "gc", x = gc, series = "raw", deviation = 100 * (gc_effect - 1))]
  )
  read_bars <- rbind(
    cpg_bias$by_x[, .(covariate = "cpg", x, reads = observed)],
    methylation_bias$by_x[, .(covariate = "methylated", x, reads = observed)],
    cpg_bias$by_gc[, .(covariate = "gc", x = gc, reads = observed)]
  )
  read_lines[, `:=`(
    covariate = factor(covariate, levels = names(covariate_labels), labels = covariate_labels),
    series = factor(series, levels = names(series_labels), labels = series_labels)
  )]
  read_bars[, covariate := factor(covariate, levels = names(covariate_labels), labels = covariate_labels)]
}
```

`r if (params$plot_gc) { paste0("Under random fragmentation, reads start uniformly along the genome, so the number of CpGs a ", window_len, " bp read covers and its GC content should follow those of all ", window_len, " bp windows of the reference. The blue lines show how much more (above 0%) or less often reads have a given value than expected; all values are taken from the reference under the read, and only reads covering at least one CpG are compared. GC content and CpG density go together, so the orange lines show what is left once each window is weighted by how over- or under-represented its GC content is. The middle panel counts the CpGs under a read that are presumably methylated: each CpG's methylation level comes from a random half of the reads, a read or window presumably holds the sum of its CpGs' levels, and only the other half of the reads is counted there; windows with a CpG that half never covers are left out. Bins with fewer than ", MIN_READS_PER_BIN, " reads are left out; the grey bars show how many reads each bin holds. Windows in unmappable sequence are expected but cannot be observed, so values typical of repeats can look under-represented.") }`

```{r offtarget_setup, include=FALSE}
is_given_file <- function(path) !is.null(path) && !is.na(path) && nchar(path) > 0 && file.exists(path)
# Coverage comes from read pairs in the BAM, so a BED-only run cannot show
# it, and Rsamtools cannot read CRAM
offtarget_enabled <- isTRUE(params$plot_offtarget) && is_given_file(params$input_bam) &&
  !grepl("\\.cram$", params$input_bam, ignore.case = TRUE) && is_given_file(params$reference)
```

## Off-target conversion

`r if (offtarget_enabled) { "The below plots show, per sequence context, how often a covered C reads as T, A or G, at loci where Rastair called no variant and no methylation. We report the strand that represent the original C (top) as well as the complementary G (bottom)." }`

```{r offtarget_data, include=FALSE}
if (offtarget_enabled) {
  suppressPackageStartupMessages({
    library(Rsamtools)
    library(Biostrings)
    library(GenomicRanges)
  })

  # Positions this close to a CpG or a variant are left out: mismatches there
  # are dominated by methylation and by misaligned variant reads
  OFFTARGET_FLANK_BP <- 2L
  # A site whose alt reads are too many for this rate of noise (one-sided
  # binomial test) is a variant Rastair did not call, not a stray mismatch.
  # A single alt read is never one, and noise rates around 1% lose almost no
  # sites, so the rate is not biased down by the sites that happen to show
  # it twice
  OFFTARGET_NOISE_RATE <- 0.02
  OFFTARGET_VARIANT_P <- 0.01
  # Fragments covering a position, both strands together
  OFFTARGET_MIN_DEPTH <- 5L
  # These only bound how much is held in memory at once, not what is counted
  VCF_CHUNK_LINES <- 500000L
  TILE_BP <- 2000000L
  SUBSTITUTIONS <- c("C>T", "C>A", "C>G")
  STRANDS <- c(converted = "Converted strand", complementary = "Complementary strand (control)")
  CONTEXTS <- paste0(rep(c("A", "C", "G", "T"), each = 3), "C", rep(c("A", "C", "T"), times = 4))
  COMPLEMENT <- c(A = "T", C = "G", G = "C", T = "A")

  scan_bam_flag <- function(include, exclude) {
    bits <- c(isPaired = 1L, isProperPair = 2L, isUnmappedQuery = 4L, hasUnmappedMate = 8L,
              isMinusStrand = 16L, isMateMinusStrand = 32L, isFirstMateRead = 64L,
              isSecondMateRead = 128L, isSecondaryAlignment = 256L,
              isNotPassingQualityControls = 512L, isDuplicate = 1024L,
              isSupplementaryAlignment = 2048L)
    args <- list()
    for (name in names(bits)) {
      if (bitwAnd(include, bits[[name]]) != 0) {
        args[[name]] <- TRUE
      } else if (bitwAnd(exclude, bits[[name]]) != 0) {
        args[[name]] <- FALSE
      }
    }
    do.call(scanBamFlag, args)
  }

  bam <- BamFile(params$input_bam)
  bam_flag <- scan_bam_flag(params$include_flags, params$exclude_flags)
  fa_index <- scanFaIndex(params$reference)
  ref_lengths <- setNames(as.integer(width(fa_index)), as.character(seqnames(fa_index)))
  mapped <- as.data.table(idxstatsBam(bam))[mapped > 0, as.character(seqnames)]

  if (region_given) {
    region <- gsub(",", "", params$region, fixed = TRUE)
    parts <- regmatches(region, regexec("^([^:]+)(?::([0-9]+)(?:-([0-9]+))?)?$", region, perl = TRUE))[[1]]
    if (length(parts) == 0 || !(parts[2] %in% names(ref_lengths))) {
      stop("Cannot estimate off-target conversion in region ", params$region)
    }
    region_chr <- parts[2]
    region_start <- if (nchar(parts[3]) > 0) as.integer(parts[3]) else 1L
    region_end <- min(if (nchar(parts[4]) > 0) as.integer(parts[4]) else ref_lengths[[region_chr]], ref_lengths[[region_chr]])
    # Padded, so that CpGs and variants just outside the region still mask
    # the positions next to them inside it
    call_region <- c("-l", paste0(region_chr, ":", max(1L, region_start - OFFTARGET_FLANK_BP - 1L), "-",
                                  min(ref_lengths[[region_chr]], region_end + OFFTARGET_FLANK_BP + 1L)))
  } else {
    call_region <- character(0)
  }

  info_field <- function(info, key) {
    fifelse(grepl(paste0("(^|;)", key, "="), info),
            sub(paste0("^(.*;)?", key, "=([^;]*).*$"), "\\2", info), NA_character_)
  }

  # One row per alt allele, keeping only what the tally needs: positions to
  # mask, and mismatches at a reference C or G
  parse_records <- function(lines) {
    if (length(lines) == 0L) {
      return(data.table())
    }
    records <- fread(text = lines, sep = "\t", header = FALSE, colClasses = "character",
                     select = c(1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10),
                     col.names = c("chr", "pos", "ref", "alt", "filter", "info", "sample"))
    # AS_SB_OT/OB hold the reference count, then one count per alt in the
    # order of ALT
    alts <- strsplit(records$alt, ",", fixed = TRUE)
    record <- rep(seq_len(nrow(records)), lengths(alts))
    allele <- sequence(lengths(alts))
    allele_counts <- function(field) {
      counts <- strsplit(field, ",", fixed = TRUE)
      flat <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(unlist(counts)))
      offset <- c(0L, cumsum(lengths(counts)))[record]
      has_allele <- lengths(counts)[record] > allele
      list(ref = flat[offset + 1L], alt = fifelse(has_allele, flat[offset + 1L + allele], NA_integer_))
    }
    ot <- allele_counts(info_field(records$info, "AS_SB_OT"))
    ob <- allele_counts(info_field(records$info, "AS_SB_OB"))
    in_cpg <- grepl("(^|;)CPG(novo)?(;|$)", records$info)
    records <- records[record, .(chr, pos = as.integer(pos), ref, filter, gt = sub(":.*", "", sample), in_cpg = in_cpg[record])]
    records[, `:=`(alt = as.character(unlist(alts)), ot_ref = ot$ref, ot_alt = ot$alt, ob_ref = ob$ref, ob_alt = ob$alt)]
    records[, called := filter == "PASS" & grepl("[1-9]", gt)]
    records[, alt_reads := ot_alt + ob_alt]
    records[, likely_variant := !is.na(alt_reads) & alt_reads > 1L &
              pbinom(alt_reads - 1L, ot_ref + ob_ref + alt_reads, OFFTARGET_NOISE_RATE, lower.tail = FALSE) < OFFTARGET_VARIANT_P]
    records[, masked := called | in_cpg | likely_variant]
    records[masked | (ref %chin% c("C", "G") & alt %chin% names(COMPLEMENT)),
            .(chr, pos, ref, alt, masked, ot_alt, ob_alt)]
  }

  tally_tile <- function(contig, tile_start, tile_end, mask, mismatches) {
    fetch_start <- max(1L, tile_start - 1L)
    fetch_end <- min(ref_lengths[[contig]], tile_end + 1L)
    sequence <- scanFa(params$reference, GRanges(contig, IRanges(fetch_start, fetch_end)))[[1]]
    bases <- strsplit(as.character(sequence), "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    n <- length(bases)
    excluded <- as.logical(coverage(restrict(shift(mask, 1L - fetch_start), 1L, n), width = n) > 0)

    rel <- seq(tile_start - fetch_start + 1L, tile_end - fetch_start + 1L)
    rel <- rel[rel > 1L & rel < n]
    rel <- rel[!excluded[rel] & bases[rel] %in% c("C", "G")]
    is_c <- bases[rel] == "C"
    context <- fifelse(is_c,
                       paste0(bases[rel - 1L], "C", bases[rel + 1L]),
                       paste0(COMPLEMENT[bases[rel + 1L]], "C", COMPLEMENT[bases[rel - 1L]]))

    reads <- as.data.table(scanBam(bam, param = ScanBamParam(
      which = GRanges(contig, IRanges(fetch_start, fetch_end)), flag = bam_flag,
      mapqFilter = 1L, what = c("qname", "flag", "pos", "cigar")
    ))[[1]])
    # A deletion inside a read counts as covered, which moves the totals by
    # about one in 10,000. A tile has few distinct CIGARs, so each is parsed
    # once.
    cigars <- unique(reads$cigar)
    on_reference <- regmatches(cigars, gregexpr("[0-9]+(?=[MDN=X])", cigars, perl = TRUE))
    reference_width <- as.integer(rowsum(as.integer(unlist(on_reference)), rep(seq_along(cigars), lengths(on_reference)), reorder = FALSE))
    reads[, end := pos - 1L + reference_width[match(cigar, cigars)]]
    reads[, ot := bitwAnd(flag, 96L) == 96L | bitwAnd(flag, 144L) == 144L]
    # Overlapping mates count once, as Rastair counts fragments, not reads:
    # the first mate is stretched over the second, which is dropped. Both
    # mates of an overlap inside the tile are always fetched.
    setorder(reads, qname, pos)
    mate_overlaps <- reads[, qname == data.table::shift(qname, fill = "") & pos <= data.table::shift(end, fill = 0L)]
    second <- which(mate_overlaps)
    reads[second - 1L, end := pmax(end, reads$end[second])]
    reads <- reads[!mate_overlaps]
    strand_coverage <- function(on_strand) {
      from <- pmax(reads$pos[on_strand], fetch_start) - fetch_start + 1L
      to <- pmin(reads$end[on_strand], fetch_end) - fetch_start + 1L
      cumsum(tabulate(from, n + 1L) - tabulate(to + 1L, n + 1L))[rel]
    }
    ot <- strand_coverage(reads$ot)
    ob <- strand_coverage(!reads$ot)

    sites <- data.table(
      pos = fetch_start - 1L + rel,
      context = context,
      converted = fifelse(is_c, ot, ob),
      complementary = fifelse(is_c, ob, ot)
    )[context %in% CONTEXTS & converted + complementary >= OFFTARGET_MIN_DEPTH]

    tile_mismatches <- mismatches[sites[, .(pos, context)], on = "pos", nomatch = NULL]
    tile_mismatches[, `:=`(
      substitution = paste0("C>", fifelse(ref == "C", alt, unname(COMPLEMENT[alt]))),
      converted = fifelse(ref == "C", ot_alt, ob_alt),
      complementary = fifelse(ref == "C", ob_alt, ot_alt)
    )]

    list(
      coverage = sites[, .(converted = sum(converted), complementary = sum(complementary)), by = context],
      mismatches = tile_mismatches[, .(converted = sum(converted, na.rm = TRUE), complementary = sum(complementary, na.rm = TRUE)), by = .(context, substitution)]
    )
  }

  tally_contig <- function(contig, records) {
    if (!(contig %in% mapped)) {
      return(list())
    }
    span <- if (region_given) c(region_start, region_end) else c(1L, ref_lengths[[contig]])
    masked <- records[masked == TRUE]
    mask <- reduce(IRanges(masked$pos - OFFTARGET_FLANK_BP, masked$pos + nchar(masked$ref) - 1L + OFFTARGET_FLANK_BP))
    mismatches <- setkey(records[masked == FALSE], pos)
    lapply(seq(span[1], span[2], by = TILE_BP), function(tile_start) {
      suppressWarnings(tally_tile(contig, tile_start, min(tile_start + TILE_BP - 1L, span[2]), mask, mismatches))
    })
  }

  # With `--all`, every position showing an alt read is written, called or
  # not, with its allele counts per strand; so is every reference CpG
  # (`CPG`), and both bases of a CpG that a called variant creates
  # (`CPGnovo`). The VCF is sorted, so each contig is tallied as soon as the
  # next one starts.
  vcf <- pipe(paste(shQuote(c(
    params$rastair, "call", "-@", params$threads, call_region, "--all",
    "--vcf-info-fields", "AS_SB,CPG,CPGnovo", "--vcf-format-fields", "GT", "--vcf", "-",
    "-r", params$reference, params$input_bam
  )), collapse = " "), open = "r")
  tallies <- list()
  pending <- list()
  repeat {
    lines <- readLines(vcf, n = VCF_CHUNK_LINES)
    if (length(lines) == 0L) {
      break
    }
    chunk <- parse_records(lines[!startsWith(lines, "#")])
    if (nrow(chunk) == 0L) {
      next
    }
    pending[[length(pending) + 1L]] <- chunk
    current <- chunk$chr[nrow(chunk)]
    if (pending[[1]]$chr[1] != current) {
      records <- rbindlist(pending)
      for (contig in setdiff(unique(records$chr), current)) {
        tallies <- c(tallies, tally_contig(contig, records[chr == contig]))
      }
      pending <- list(records[chr == current])
    }
  }
  status <- close(vcf)
  if (status != 0L) {
    stop("rastair call failed with status ", status)
  }
  records <- rbindlist(pending)
  for (contig in unique(records$chr)) {
    tallies <- c(tallies, tally_contig(contig, records[chr == contig]))
  }

  coverage_by_context <- rbindlist(lapply(tallies, `[[`, "coverage"))[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = context]
  mismatches_by_context <- rbindlist(lapply(tallies, `[[`, "mismatches"))
  if (nrow(mismatches_by_context) > 0) {
    mismatches_by_context <- mismatches_by_context[, lapply(.SD, sum), by = .(context, substitution)]
  }
  covered_bases <- melt(coverage_by_context, id.vars = "context",
                        variable.name = "strand", value.name = "bases", variable.factor = FALSE)
  rates <- CJ(context = CONTEXTS, substitution = SUBSTITUTIONS, strand = names(STRANDS))
  rates <- merge(rates, covered_bases, by = c("context", "strand"), all.x = TRUE)
  if (nrow(mismatches_by_context) > 0) {
    mismatch_counts <- melt(mismatches_by_context, id.vars = c("context", "substitution"),
                            variable.name = "strand", value.name = "mismatches", variable.factor = FALSE)
    rates <- merge(rates, mismatch_counts, by = c("context", "substitution", "strand"), all.x = TRUE)
  } else {
    rates[, mismatches := 0L]
  }
  rates[is.na(bases), bases := 0]
  rates[is.na(mismatches), mismatches := 0]

  # Poisson rates with exact 95% intervals
  poisson_rates <- function(table) {
    table[, `:=`(
      rate = fifelse(bases > 0, mismatches / bases, NA_real_),
      rate_lo = fifelse(bases > 0, qchisq(0.025, 2 * mismatches) / 2 / bases, NA_real_),
      rate_hi = fifelse(bases > 0, qchisq(0.975, 2 * mismatches + 2) / 2 / bases, NA_real_)
    )]
  }
  poisson_rates(rates)
  rates[, `:=`(
    context = factor(context, levels = CONTEXTS),
    substitution = factor(substitution, levels = SUBSTITUTIONS),
    strand = factor(strand, levels = names(STRANDS), labels = STRANDS)
  )]
  overall_rates <- poisson_rates(rates[, .(mismatches = sum(mismatches), bases = sum(bases)), by = .(substitution, strand)])
}
```
```{r offtarget_plot, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.height=6, fig.width=9}
if (offtarget_enabled) {
  dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.85)
  ggplot(rates, aes(x = context, y = rate, fill = substitution)) +
    geom_col(position = dodge, width = 0.8) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = rate_lo, ymax = rate_hi), position = dodge, width = 0.3, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey30") +
    facet_wrap(vars(strand), ncol = 1) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("C>T" = "#2a78d6", "C>A" = "#eb6834", "C>G" = "#1baf7a"), name = NULL) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    labs(x = "Sequence context", y = "Mismatches per covered base") +
    theme_light() +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      strip.background = element_blank(),
      strip.text = element_text(colour = "grey20", hjust = 0, size = rel(1)),
      legend.position = "top"
    )
}
```

```{r offtarget_table, echo=FALSE}
  overall_table <- dcast(overall_rates, substitution ~ strand, value.var = "rate")
  knitr::kable(
    overall_table[, lapply(.SD, function(rate) sprintf("%.3g%%", 100 * rate)), by = substitution],
    caption = "Mismatch rate over all contexts"
  )
```
